title: feat(plugin-grid,types,react): ObjectGrid takes onNavigate as a prop that wins over schema.onNavigate, and the four onNavigate faces take one closed token, RecordNavigateAction (objectui#9547)
body:
Fixes #9547
Clause-②: yes

## What this does

Ruling C on this card (decision batch 166, item 1, comment `5731678470`, maintainer 「同意」), step 3, in one pass now that objectui resolves `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 (triage probe `5904192911`):

- `ObjectGridComponentProps` declares `onNavigate?: (recordId: string | number, action: RecordNavigateAction) => void`, and `ObjectGrid` reads `onNavigate: onNavigate ?? schema.onNavigate` — the ruling's `props.onNavigate ?? schema.onNavigate`, spelled with the destructured prop the way its nine siblings are. When both are supplied, the prop wins.
- `RecordNavigateAction = 'view' | 'new_window'` is a new type export of `@object-ui/types`, and all four faces take it: the new prop, `ObjectGridSchema.onNavigate`, `ListViewRuntimeProps.onNavigate` (so `ListViewSchema['onNavigate']`), and `UseNavigationOverlayOptions.onNavigate` in `@object-ui/react`. Each face opens with the same sentence. ⛔ No interim `string`, ⛔ no `'edit'`.
- The two docblocks that counted "nine siblings" now count ten: the programmatic-only note on `ObjectGridSchema.onNavigate`, and the read-site exemption comment in `ObjectGrid.tsx`. Every pinned phrase of both is unchanged.
- `gridNonAuthorKeys.test.tsx`: the read-line anchor is re-aimed at `onNavigate: onNavigate ?? schema.onNavigate,`, by content.
- New `onNavigateProp-9547.test.tsx`: the ruling's two pins (the prop is wired in `page` mode; the prop beats the schema key), plus a modifier click handing the prop `'new_window'`, type-level pins that each face's second parameter IS `RecordNavigateAction` and is required, and a read of the spec catalogue row against the union.
- `.changeset/9547-ongrid-onnavigate-prop.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/react`, with the Clause-② paragraph and what a host has to change.

Two commits: `1432197b88` (the type and the three sibling faces), `0c73dfb843` (the prop, the read, the pins, the changeset), then `fc90ce532d` merges `main` at `0389650f3c` (it brought PR #10278, objectui#9853, into `ObjectGrid.tsx` / `objectql.ts` / `objectql.zod.ts`; no conflict and no hunk near `onNavigate`).

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **Held, with one correction.** On `846cec0efe`: `ObjectGridComponentProps` declared no `onNavigate`; the grid read `onNavigate: schema.onNavigate`. In `objectql.ts`, `ObjectGridSchema.onNavigate` and `ListViewRuntimeProps.onNavigate` were `(recordId, action?: string)`; the `'view' | 'edit'` declaration is `ObjectViewSchema.onNavigate` — a different channel (`plugin-view`'s `ObjectView` invokes it with `'new'` / `'edit'` / `'view'` itself), not one of the ruling's three sibling faces, and it is untouched. `UseNavigationOverlayOptions` lives in `packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts`, typed `(recordId, action?: string)`.
2. **Falsified.** The installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 exports no TypeScript type for the union: `onNavigate` occurs in none of its `.d.ts` files, and `'view' | 'new_window'` occurs only as the `type` STRING of the `onNavigate` row in the `ListView` entry of `REACT_BLOCKS` (`dist/ui/index.mjs`). objectstack `main` (`05a7547c9f`) is the same. ⇒ the literal is spelled once, as `RecordNavigateAction`, and the spec-row case in the new test fails if the two vocabularies part.
3. **Held.** `handleClick` in `useNavigationOverlay` calls `onNavigate` at four sites: two pass `'new_window'`, two pass `'view'`, none passes `'edit'` (the retired `navigation.view` read is already gone). The option is now typed against the union, so a third token there is a compile error. The pins assert that `('1', 'view')` in `page` mode and `('1', 'new_window')` on a meta-click reach the prop.
4. **Held.** No test counts `ObjectGridComponentProps` members; the "nine" census is the two docblocks' prose. `NINE_SIBLINGS` in `gridNonAuthorKeys.test.tsx` asserts the nine are NOT declared on `ObjectGridSchema`, which stays true, so it is unchanged.

## Files outside the claim's list, and why

- `packages/types/src/index.ts` — one barrel line exporting `RecordNavigateAction`; "one place, reused" across three packages needs the export.
- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`, `packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` — comments only. Two contrasted `ObjectViewSchema.onNavigate` with "the grid's `action?: string`" and two quoted the grid's read as `onNavigate: schema.onNavigate`. This change made all four false, so they now name the new type and quote the new read.

## What a host sees

- A handler written `(id, action?: string) => …`, or with one parameter, still compiles and receives what it received before.
- A handler annotated with a union that leaves out `'new_window'` (the old docblock's `'view' | 'edit'`) is refused with TS2322. Measured with a throwaway probe compiled by `plugin-grid`'s `tsconfig.test.json` and deleted afterwards: TS2322 on a `'view' | 'edit'` handler, TS2345 on a call passing `'edit'`, TS2554 on a call omitting the token, no error on the two accepted shapes.
- In-repo consumers that pass a handler (`app-shell`'s `ObjectView`, `InterfaceListPage`, `ObjectDataPage`; `plugin-gantt`'s `ObjectGantt`; `plugin-list`'s `ListView`) all type-check unchanged.
